Abe Goldfarb is a voice actor for the English-language dub of . He is currently affiliated with Bohemian Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Goldfarb is an American actor, writer, and voice actor who trained at the and has worked with such companies as the , Studio 42, and the . Goldfarb joined the in the middle of . His most prominent roles are Xerosic and .
